run_train_model: run the Omnimatte training script with --dataroot and --name flags to train on a video dataset
run_train_with_tensorboard: run the training script with a SummaryWriter to log losses and learning rates to TensorBoard
run_train_with_callbacks: run the training script with load_data and checkpoint callbacks for custom data and checkpoint handling
review_main_function: review the main function that parses TrainOptions, creates the dataset, model, and visualizer before training
review_train_loop: review the train function that manages epochs, optimizes parameters, logs losses, and saves model checkpoints
